data.title: Commit or Rollback
data.statement:
Start with a provisional value and a confirmed value, both equal to {{0}}. Process the commands in order:

{{ADD}} [[x]]: add the integer [[x]] to the provisional value.
{{COMMIT}}: copy the provisional value to the confirmed value. The provisional value stays unchanged.
{{ROLLBACK}}: restore the provisional value to the confirmed value. The confirmed value stays unchanged.

Print the final <<confirmed value>>. Ignore any changes that have not been committed.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Start with a provisional value and a confirmed value, both equal to 0. Process the commands in order:

ADD x: add the integer x to the provisional value.
COMMIT: copy the provisional value to the confirmed value. The provisional value stays unchanged.
ROLLBACK: restore the provisional value to the confirmed value. The confirmed value stays unchanged.

Print the final confirmed value. Ignore any changes that have not been committed.
Input
Line 1: An integer n, the number of commands.
Next n lines: A command: ADD x, COMMIT or ROLLBACK. Commands are uppercase. ADD and x are separated by one space.
Output
One integer: the final confirmed value.
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 100
-1000 ≤ x ≤ 1000
Every command is valid.
Example
Input
7
ADD 5
COMMIT
ADD 7
ROLLBACK
ADD -2
COMMIT
ADD 9
Output
3
